g.text: Written by main, touch and shell paths
Boxes group existing responsibilities; they are not enforced source layers.
All application .c files currently live in bringup-zephyr/src/.
Direct Zephyr access and service -> control dependencies still exist.
SD mounts a filesystem; captured audio clips currently remain in RAM.
MON supervision is distributed; the dedicated MON module is a target design.
Created by GPT-6.1-Sol on behalf of Nico running in codex.
